question.text: Which of the following is the CORRECT list of platforms where an FPE can list its EQUITY securities under the SSE framework?

answer.text: Only on IGP, mandated by SEBI for all SEs
Main Board (NSE/BSE), SME platform (NSE-EMERGE/BSE SME), OR Innovators Growth Platform (IGP)

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 3.3.1 lists three equity-listing platforms for FPEs: Main Board (NSE/BSE), SME platform (NSE-EMERGE / BSE SME), or Innovators Growth Platform (IGP). The platform choice depends on size (SME uses lower post-issue paid-up limits) and sector (IGP was designed for tech / innovation-heavy FPEs). SSE itself is for registration / disclosure — the trading board is the existing one. The Trap: Options A, C, D each drop one or more options. Candidates often think SSE is 'one new board' — it's actually a segment overlay that re-uses existing boards for FPE securities and creates a new board only for NPO ZCZP (tested in Topic 4). Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C (Compliance), XV (RA), and XII (SMF) all test Main Board / SME / IGP distinctions. XIX-A (AIF) touches IGP for startups. XXIII uses this as context for SE differentiators. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Confirm the chosen equity-board early because differentiator disclosures (Table 3.2) are ADDITIONAL to the standard ICDR main-board prospectus content. The SIA's assurance scope must add the differentiators on top of the base ICDR schedule — don't assume one subsumes the other.
